source_data_cutoff: previous completed UTC day, downloaded before freezing
receipt_policy: first immutable receipt per calendar/session; no replacement or backfill
notes: Prospective parameter/policy freezing followed by simulated evaluation, not live orders or broker fills.
Crypto day-D fits apply no earlier than D+1 and use archives only through D-1. Training replays that observation lag.
Stock/ETF receipts freeze before 09:30 ET. Listed-buy sample lag is retained. Half-day closes apply to both sides.
GitHub artifact creation must precede the freeze deadline. Unsealed records are pending, never prospective evidence.
All methods share frozen receipt coverage. Missing/late receipts are failures, never retrospectively filled.
First receipt wins across retries. Registry or execution-code changes require a new experiment.
ETF inputs remain spot proxies. Fees and fills are hypothetical. No proxy or paper result is actual execution performance.
Existing production workflows, pages, parameters and broker behavior are outside this experiment's write scope.
